name: hx1-reconsider-ignore-cl
description: B91..B105 (fork A90) is the tip when a lock on A100 marks B91..B105 conflicting and reorgs to A100; reconsiderblock(B91) leaves the marks; reconsiderblock(B91, ignore_chainlocks=true) clears B91's alone (B92.. keep theirs), so A100 stays the tip; a CLSIG for B105 whose signature fails is not recorded or relayed
